thread.title: Trader bets on Apple rebound

author: InvestorsObserver
title: Trader bets on Apple rebound
text:
Shutterstock photo Traders are betting Monday that Apple ( AAPL ) will rebound before next summer. So far, 4,075 contracts of the July 2019 220 call have changed hands, against open interest of 242 contracts. Today's volume has been largely in the high side of the bid-ask spread, indicating that these new contracts are likely initiated from the buy side. InvestorsKeyhole Trade Alert IK-> The technicals for AAPL ($170.84 down $1.45) are bearish with a downward trend. The stock has support around 167.30. Look at the Dec. 140/145 bull-put spread for a 23-cent credit. That's a 4.8% return and the stock has to fall by 15.1% to cause a problem. [InvestorsKeyhole, various news and data services]
